Biography

Leandro Taibbi is a Milan-based producer, DJ and live performer working between hypnotic techno and experimental electronics. Born in Caltanissetta, Sicily in 1996, he came to electronic music as a self-taught obsessive — taking apart sounds, machines and software long before he ever stood behind a mixer.

His practice is built on hands-on experimentation with modular synthesizers, Max for Live and Ableton, with a particular pull toward west-coast synthesis and the Buchla and Serge worlds. Rather than chasing presets or trends, he treats the system as an instrument to be patched, pushed and listened to — voltage, repetition and texture shaping music that is at once rigorous and physical.

That approach carries straight into his sets, which blur the line between DJ performance and live electronics: intense, looping, hypnotic and unapologetically technical — no concessions to trend, only to the machine.

He has released on Diffuse Reality, Rowan Underground, Ithica, CommonSense Records, Risonanze Asettiche and Dolma Rec, and keeps an extensive independent catalogue on Bandcamp, where his work in modular synthesis, rhythmic deconstruction and tonal minimalism has found a dedicated audience; his YouTube channel documents the process behind the music. He has performed across Milan, Turin, Catania, Birmingham and Zurich, and his work has drawn the support of Richie Hawtin, Richard Devine, Mind Against, Colin Benders, Todd Barton and Ali3n — names spanning club techno, sound design and the west-coast synthesis lineage.
